dish.n: Corned beef in parsley white sauce on toast
dish.note: Sliced corned beef in parsley white sauce on thick toast, a plain 1960s tea.
dish.how: Melt 50g butter, stir in 50g plain flour for 1 minute and whisk in 500ml warm milk until thick, about 8 minutes. Add 3 tbsp chopped parsley, a pinch of nutmeg and pepper. Fold in 400g of thickly sliced cooked corned beef from the deli and warm through for 4 minutes. Serve over 8 slices of thick toasted white bread.

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute and whisk in the milk until thick.
Stir in the parsley, nutmeg and pepper.
Fold in the corned beef and warm through.
Toast the bread and spoon the beef and sauce over.

dish.make_ahead: Make the sauce up to 1 day ahead and reheat with a splash of milk

veg.n: Egg in parsley white sauce on toast (vegetarian)

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute and whisk in the milk until thick.
Stir in the parsley, nutmeg and pepper and fold in the halved eggs.
Toast the bread and spoon the eggs and sauce over.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sauce up to 1 day ahead and reheat with a splash of milk

dish.vegNote: Halved boiled eggs in the same white sauce instead of corned beef
